# AiBhive — full LLM corpus
# https://aibhive.com/llms-full.txt
# Companion to https://aibhive.com/llms.txt — curated page summaries for AI agents.

> AiBhive is an AI app factory and agentic automation platform. Build apps in plain English (Bhive Builder), install community tools (Hive Apps), research with archive scraping/OCR/translation (Research Lab), and deploy enterprise multi-agent workflows.

## What is AiBhive?

AiBhive helps individuals and businesses ship software and automation without traditional development cycles. Three public product surfaces matter most:

1. **Bhive Builder / App hub** (`/app`, `/hive-apps/build`) — describe a mobile app, web app, site, or dashboard in plain English; the builder delivers a working app. Bring your own API keys (BYOK) or use Hive credits.
2. **Hive Apps** (`/hive-apps`) — a community pool of installable tools. Try demos, install free apps, tweak existing ones, or commission custom builds from a few dollars.
3. **Research Lab** (`/research-lab`) — multi-agent community-sourced research: Fable Scrape, OCR Lab, translation (including historical scripts), Grok synthesis, and a shared discovery library. Category hubs: Historical & Ancient, Medical & Holistic, Legal Findings, Academia & Scholarly. Metered with Hive credits; monthly Pro/Unlimited plans renew research allowances.

4. **AiBhive Pros** (`/pros`, `/pros/{trade}`) — field-service platform for HVAC, pool, electrical, plumbing, fiber, and property management: living shop knowledge, dispatch context, and integration with AiBhive Diagnose.

5. **AiBhive Diagnose** (`/diagnose`) — web landing for the trade diagnosis app: AI chat, photo vision, guided fault flows, code/safety references, and trade-specific packs (Android app at `/diagnose/app` — private, not for indexing).

Enterprise customers also deploy **agentic workflows** for real estate (listings, missed-call text-back, CRM), lead generation, customer ops, document/ERP processing, phone/SMS, and regulated medical/legal transcription.

## Home — https://aibhive.com/

AiBhive positions as an AI app factory plus agentic automation platform. Primary offers: build apps without coding, browse Hive Apps, run Research Lab tools, and book enterprise strategy for multi-agent operations. Best for founders, agents, operators, and creators who want production tools fast.

## App hub — https://aibhive.com/app

Command center for Bhive Builder on web. Users build mobile apps, web apps, and sites; explore topic hubs (automated social, phone intelligence, lead generation, productivity, research); and manage Hive credits. Same builder model as the Android app.

## Build a Hive App — https://aibhive.com/hive-apps/build

Guided flow: describe the app in plain English, review a quote, approve, and Bhive Builder constructs it in the browser. Designed for non-developers and power users who want custom tools without writing code.

## Hive Apps store — https://aibhive.com/hive-apps

Community storefront. First apps are inexpensive ($1–$5 range messaging). Users browse store listings, try web runners, install free community apps, and share improvements. Demo runners include resume bot, research/OSINT, job hunter, social post hunter, homework bot, meeting burn, focus reactor, house flip calculator, and a mock real estate dashboard. **AiBhivePlants** is the flagship community field guide at https://aibhive.com/plants (legacy hive runner redirects).

## AiBhivePlants — https://aibhive.com/plants

**AiBhivePlants** is a free community living knowledge base for edible wild plants, mushrooms, and adjacent research libraries across Oregon and Northern California. Available on the web and as a direct-download Android APK (`AiBhivePlants.apk`) while Google Play approval is pending. **Not the main AiBhive product** — indexed for search and AI discovery.

### Android app
- **Download:** https://aibhive.com/api/download/plants-apk (filename: `AiBhivePlants.apk`)
- **Package:** `com.aibhive.plants` — WebView shell loading `https://aibhive.com/plants?mobile=1`
- **Google Play:** listing pending; direct APK install supported

### Core plant library
- **178+ species** with three ID photos each, habitat notes, toxic look-alikes, harvest and preparation ideas, regional filters (Oregon coast, Willamette Valley, Northern California), and downloadable PDF field guides.
- **Site search** across plants, edibles, holistic topics, hypnosis/energy, animal health, featured essays, and community posts.
- **Community feed** — member posts with photos, comments, and upvotes on plants, essays, and research topics.
- **Featured essays** — long-form Grok-authored pieces (e.g. foraging philosophy, plant intelligence) embedded in home and library grids.
- **Living Knowledge Ask agent** — offline RAG answers from the bundled library; optional Grok enhancement; photo plant ID via vision (Hive credits).
- **Ask AiBhive** — paid per-question Grok chat with library context (Hive credits). Browsing, search, and community posts stay free.
- **Contribute** — community post form for field notes; **$3 Hive credits** to add a new US state to the regional map.

### Adjacent research libraries (same app, separate tabs)
- **Herbs** — https://aibhive.com/plants/herbs — Western herbalism, TCM, Ayurveda, PNW materia medica. Not medical advice.
- **Supplements** — https://aibhive.com/plants/supplements — vitamins, minerals, omega-3, probiotics. Not medical advice.
- **Holistic remedies & protocols** — https://aibhive.com/plants/holistic-remedies-and-protocols — 35+ topics with deep-dive articles, images, Edgar Cayce–inspired remedies, detox overviews, safety warnings. Educational only; not medical advice.
- **Hypnosis & energy** — https://aibhive.com/plants/hypnosis-and-energy — past life regression, Edgar Cayce, Dolores Cannon QHHT, clinical hypnotherapy, Reiki, chakras, tuning forks, Solfeggio frequencies. Not therapy or medical care.
- **Animal health** — https://aibhive.com/plants/animal-health — holistic veterinary education for dogs, cats, horses, livestock. Not veterinary advice.

### URLs and redirects
- Canonical home: `https://aibhive.com/plants`
- Android APK: `https://aibhive.com/api/download/plants-apk` (`AiBhivePlants.apk`)
- Legacy runner `/hive-apps/run/example-oregon-plant-medicine` redirects to `/plants`
- Brand names: **AiBhivePlants** (product), “Earth's Plant Medicine” (hero), “Community Living Knowledgebase” (nav)

## AiBhive Pros — https://aibhive.com/pros

Trade-company HQ for field service: grow a living knowledge base from every truck, coordinate jobs, and pair with AiBhive Diagnose. Trade landing pages: HVAC, property management, pool, electrical, plumbing, fiber.

## AiBhive Diagnose — https://aibhive.com/diagnose

AI-assisted diagnosis for field technicians — photo vision, guided flows, fault trees, NEC/pool/HVAC references. Web landing for the Android Pros companion; authenticated app routes are not indexed.

## Field Service AI (enterprise) — https://aibhive.com/solutions/field-service-ai

Enterprise solution page tying AiBhive Pros (company HQ, dispatch, roster, periodic GPS, living knowledge base) with AiBhive Diagnose (Grok chat, photo vision, 100+ fault playbooks, six trade packs: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pool, property, fiber). Covers the diagnose → document → compound knowledge loop, FSM integrations, and pairing with phone/SMS automation.

## Research Lab — https://aibhive.com/research-lab

Landing for AiBhive’s multi-agent research suite (Research tools). Users scrape archives (including sites that block naive bots via Fable Scrape), run OCR, translate texts (modern and historical scripts), ask Grok-powered questions over a RAG library, and publish findings to a community-sourced library so other researchers can build on shared sources. Hive credits meter usage; Pro ($20/mo) and Unlimited ($50/mo) renew monthly allowances. Workspace tools require sign-in (`/research-lab/workspace` — not for indexing of private sessions).

### Research Lab · Historical & Ancient — https://aibhive.com/research-lab/historical-ancient

Expert hub for archive harvest, ancient/modern script translation, OCR of fragile plates, and community corpus publishing. Emphasizes multi-agent start-to-finish historical investigation. Includes the Communal Library topic **Nag Hammadi & Gnostic** (`/research-lab/communal-library/nag-hammadi`) with a complete NHL tractate catalog and dig packs at `/api/research-lab/nag-hammadi-finds` for word-indexing published Gnostic texts.

### Research Lab · Medical & Holistic — https://aibhive.com/research-lab/medical-holistic

Literature and protocol research for clinical and integrative work: OCR, translation, Grok synthesis, optional BYOK, and de-identified community literature packs.

### Research Lab · Legal Findings — https://aibhive.com/research-lab/legal-findings

Docket/exhibit OCR, foreign opinion translation, Grok issue outlines, and public-domain finding packs — not legal advice; confidentiality-minded.

### Research Lab · Academia & Scholarly — https://aibhive.com/research-lab/academia-scholarly

Corpus-first scholarly workflows: harvest, OCR, multilingual lit review, Grok literature maps, and open dataset publishing to the communal library.

## Fable Scrape — https://aibhive.com/fable-scrape

AI research harvester: tell agents what to find; they crawl with stealth engines, filter content, route through residential proxies when needed, OCR documents, translate with user-chosen models, and publish into a communal library. Guide: https://aibhive.com/fable-scrape/guide

## OCR Lab — https://aibhive.com/ocr-lab

Batch vision OCR: upload up to ~100 photos and export formatted text, Markdown, or PDF. Built for archives, scanned books, handwritten notes, and research images.

## Real estate AI tools — https://aibhive.com/tools/real-estate-ai

Intent-mapped guide for agents, investors, and property managers covering:

- Listing description writers (MLS-ready copy)
- Real estate video / content AI
- CRM & lead automation
- Missed-call text-back
- Property management dashboards

Enterprise depth: https://aibhive.com/solutions/real-estate-ai-automation

## Transcription Studio — https://aibhive.com/transcription

Multi-agent transcription for general, legal, and medical audio. Specialized agents cross-check acoustic, linguistic, and domain jargon claims to target higher accuracy than single-model STT. Related use cases: podcasters, YouTubers, legal, medical.

## Voice Clone Lab — https://aibhive.com/voice-clone

Neural voice cloning for creators and businesses. Preserve tone and emotion across 10+ languages for dubbed content and localized growth. Tied to Grow Globally ROI narrative (`/grow`).

## Crawl policy notes

Public marketing and product guide pages allow major search and AI crawlers (see robots.txt). Disallowed: `/homework`, `/admin`, `/test`, `/hive-apps/embed`, `/app/settings`, `/research-lab/workspace`, `/pros/app`, `/diagnose/app`.
